_doc: Monster camps (scripts/match/camps.gd, docs/decisions/0048-camps-and-xp.md). kind_size: a map camp spot's layout kind -> its size. sizes, smallest first (the hot zone and a comeback are the next one up): name (player text), n monsters, big (the one big monster: the region's version of it), armor (the bundle's armor), orb (chance 0..1 of a perk orb, source 'camp'), gear (if set: one gear piece, this many rarity steps over the region's), big_rar (rarity steps over its roll for the big one). small: the small kinds when a camp has no region table. A camp's XP is the sum of its monsters (content/rules/xp.json). back_s: a cleared camp comes back once, this long after its clear (s), if no Hunter is within back_clear_r (m) and the spot is safe for back_safe_s (s); none after back_until_s (match s). max_mobs: camp monsters alive at once. spread (m): how far monsters stand from the camp's centre. bots (scripts/match/bot_camps.gd, docs/decisions/0060-bots-play-camps.md): crown_pick, the chance a bot leader tries the Crown first (one bot squad a match at most); home_s, until this match time (s) a bot squad clears the region it pinged, smallest camp first (spec 2.8: objectives from 2:00); safe_s (s) and blight_r (m), it leaves a camp when the spot is not safe that long or the Blight is that near; rival_r (m), a camp with a squad of more total levels this close is skipped, and a rival this close is what the squad remembers for seen_s; together_r (m), a squadmate further than this from the squad's leader walks to it (inside xp.json share_r, so the squad shares the XP); detour_r (m), after home_s a squad at or below the pace level goes to a live camp this close; pace_s, the match time (s) each level is due, level 1 first (spec 6.2; moves to the XP rules when they carry the pace); glide_k, a bot squad pings only a camp within this share of the canopy's glide after the launch's dive from where the ship lets it jump (the ship's ride ends before its run does). steal (spec 6.8; a prize monster is a camp's Brute or Chief): bold, the bot skill (0..1) from which a bot tries steals; r (m), how close the prize monster must be; hp, the share of its health under which it is in its kill window; try, the chance a bold bot goes for the last hit (rolled once per monster); hold_hp, a squad that saw a rival in the last seen_s (s) keeps its abilities while the monster is between hp and this share, to spend them inside the window.
